comparison.objective: Install three gears on shafts while finding tooth phase and meshing adjacent pairs; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bore-shaft insertion, contact-guided tooth phasing, sequential meshing, and release versus fine hex access, collar tuning, socket reacquisition, and guarded impact testing.
comparison.success_condition: All gears must be seated within 2 mm/1 mm/3 degrees, meshed, still, released, and clear for 1 second in the final versions. Candidate instead scores dynamic stopping and setting retention.
comparison.reason: Gear-train assembly and tooth-phase discovery are materially different from adjustable damping commissioning.
